channel.title: SCC Online Web Edition - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from SCC Online Web Edition (scconline.com)

item.title: Invitation for Seminar | NUJS Centre for Sports Law & Policy (CSLP) | Career in Sports Law | Webinar Series
item.description: NUJS CSLP will host a webinar on careers in sports law featuring Prof. Subhrajit Chanda, covering academia, policy, and commercial sports practice.

item.title: Companies (Specification of Definition Details) Amendment Rules, 2025: Expansion of Threshold Limit for Small Companies
item.description: Companies (Specification of definition details) Amendment Rules 2025 expands of threshold limit for small company to ₹10 crores capital and ₹100 crores turnover.

item.title: HIGH COURT WEEKLY ROUNDUP 2025 [24th to 30th November] | Amit Baghel's Hate Speech; Hermes' Birkin Bag; Gold Flake Trade Mark; and more
item.description: High Court Weekly Roundup for 24 to 30th November 2025: Read stories on Amit Baghel's Hate Speech; Hermes' Birkin Bag; Gold Flake Trade Mark; etc

item.title: DPIIT-IPR Chair | CNLU Patna | National Consumer Awareness Workshop on Mitigating Deception in Trademarks Practices
item.description: CNLU Patna hosts a national workshop on consumer awareness and trademark deception under the PIIT-IPR Chair, highlighting risks of confusingly similar and counterfeit marks. (149 characters)

item.title: Parity cannot be the sole ground for bail: Supreme Court emphasises Role Differentiation among Co-Accused
item.description: Supreme Court rules that Courts cannot grant bail on parity as sole ground and emphasised on the gravity of the offence, accused's role, and proper reasoning in bail orders.

item.title: Read why Delhi HC held insurance policies issued after IRDAI's 2023 circular containing arbitration clause constitute a valid arbitration agreement
item.description: Delhi High Court held that insurance policies with arbitration clause, issued after the release of IRDAI 2023 circular, constituted a valid arbitration agreement.

item.title: Call for Participation| ICFAI Law School | ICFAI University, Dehradun | N.J.Y. Memorial International Moot Court Competition, 2026
item.description: ICFAI Dehradun will host the N.J.Y. Memorial International Moot Court Competition on 7-8 February 2026 featuring national and international teams.

item.title: SCC Online signs MoU with The Dialogue to Strengthen Legal and Policy Research
item.description: SCC Online signed MoU with public policy think-tank The Dialogue

item.title: Pre-constitutional record decisive; Bombay High Court dismisses petition against Kunbi caste claim
item.description: Bombay High Court dismisses petition challenging Kunbi OBC caste validity, holding pre-constitutional records decisive and fraud allegations unsustainable.

item.title: RBI's Comprehensive Framework of 244 Directions: Strengthening Governance, Compliance, and Financial Stability
item.description: RBI issues directions and notifications, covering credit, compliance, governance, and prudential norms for banks and financial institutions.
